p.i: illa continet, tibi dicandum iure statuimus. In quo illustrissimi quique ab orbe condito ad tuum usque Regnum homines, qui duplicem hanc, aut alterutram immortalitatis viam affectarunt: & imagine vivacissimè picta, & historia verissimè scripta, per succedentium temporum, & Imperiorum seriem spectantur, tanquam in triumphali pompa procedentes: capi-tibus tantum per lunarem veluti fenestellam promi-nentibus: ex quibus, quasi leonem ab unguibus reli-quam corporis faciem, sed & mentem ipsamφυσιογνωμικῶς licet estimare. Hoc igitur polycephalon opus curiosa conquisitione investigatum, & multis vigiliis elabo-ratum, tua inclytissima Maiestatis Imperio tueri dignabere: quod sanè jam non nostrum, sed tuum absoluto dedicationis voto esse incipit: cùm Rex ille sis, cui & labores nostros, & res nostras, & nosmetipsos debere profitemur.

page.notes: The Greek marginal word φυσιογνωμικῶς is small and slightly faint; the accents are read as printed but may be imprecise. The signature at the foot-left (ɛ4 r) is faint and uncertain. Show-through from the reverse page (mirrored lines, asterisks and a grey rectangle at the right) is not transcribed. No page number or running head is printed. The line "inuestigatum" was rendered as "investigatum" by the u/v rule. Printing errors, if any, are left as printed.
